title: Christ is our hope
text:
God made you to glorify him and to enjoy him forever. But we have all sinned. We have not loved God with all our heart, and we have not loved our neighbor as ourselves. Sin is not only what we do. It lives in the heart, and it deserves God's just anger and death (Romans 3:23; 6:23).

God did not leave us there. He sent his Son. The Lord Jesus Christ, true God and true man, lived the perfect obedience we owed. He died on the cross, bearing the curse that sinners deserve. He was buried, and on the third day he rose again. Now he reigns, and he prays for his people (1 Corinthians 15:3-4; Romans 8:34).

God calls you to turn from your sin and trust in Christ alone. You cannot earn pardon with your effort, your sorrow, or your progress. It is a free gift, received by faith. All who trust in Christ are forgiven, counted righteous for his sake, and adopted as God's children (Romans 3:24-26; John 1:12).

That is why this app exists. You do not put sin to death to make God love you. You put sin to death because in Christ he already loves you. The Holy Spirit joins believers to Christ and gives them strength to put to death the deeds of the body (Romans 8:13). Every page here is meant to send you back to him: to his Word, to prayer, to the Lord's Day, and to his people in your church.
pathText:
You do not need to have everything settled before you come to Christ. He receives sinners who come to him, and he turns none away (John 6:37).

Read the Gospel of John slowly, and ask God to show you his Son. Go to a faithful church on the Lord's Day and hear the Word preached. Speak with the pastor there about your questions and doubts. He will be glad to talk with you.

You may use this app while you seek the Lord. But it cannot save you, and fighting sin will not make you right with God. Only Christ can do that. Look to him.
